To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the BitTorrent file availability is not stable in small communities and a novel peer selection strategy can improve the system's stability and the file availability.

(i) the peer distribution in the stable state follows a U-shaped function; (ii) the system's stability is deteriorated by the clustering of the download peers; (iii) the unchoking strategy in BitTorrent could not help to improve the file availability when the size of community is small; and (iv) the peer selection strategy proposed in this paper can improve the system's stability and prolong its life time.

(1) BitTorrent file sharing networks are unstable in a small community, and (2) a peer selection strategy which considers both the current download rate as well as the future service availability could improve the stability of a BitTorrent network in a small community.
